concept.literalSynthesis: A jester's star musket fed by fallen stars: the musket identity remains the weapon, while each spent fallen star becomes its own brief answering spark on a hit.
concept.coreMechanic: Fire a 31-damage ranged shot every 32 ticks (about 0.533 seconds). Each shot consumes one fallen-star ammo unit and follows a deliberate gravity arc. The shot can pierce up to three NPCs; each actual hit can admit one separate 14-damage star that homes slowly for up to 1.25 seconds. The secondary output is a hit reward, not a free extra shot on a miss, and it shares the event spawn budget. The main shot retains the musket's one-ammo-per-shot economy and its useful three-target pierce, while the stars add bounded follow-up damage for the same ammo cost. The source weapon was Blue rarity, valued at 77,600 copper, and had 32-tick use timing; the fallen star is a consumable material in the fallen_star ammo category with no positive observed damage contribution. These facts do not establish a progression tier, so the added output is kept modest and finite rather than treating the ammo identity as evidence for exceptional power.
concept.parentAContribution: The Jester's Star Musket supplies the musket identity, ranged class, 31 base damage, 5.25 knockback, 32-tick use tempo, and the observed fallen-star ammo requirement. Its source projectile had a three-hit pierce and a 1.5-second lifetime. The authored arc and hit-born star are new mechanics, not claims about the parent's observed behavior.
concept.parentBContribution: The Fallen Star supplies the literal fallen-star identity and the exact fallen_star ammo category. It is a consumable material with no positive observed damage contribution; here it pays for each musket shot, and the separate homing child is a new authored effect rather than an inherited ammo ability.
concept.playerExperience: Aim and fire the visible musket normally. Each shot consumes one fallen star; a successful hit may add a brief homing follow-up, while a miss spends ammo without spawning one. The one-ammo cost, source-paced cadence, three-hit pierce and finite child lifetime keep the extra damage tied to successful hits.

plannedPlayerActions.intent: Fire one cursor-aimed, gravity-arc ranged shot and consume one fallen-star ammo unit; actual NPC hits can each produce a distinct, briefly homing star.

realization.description: Fire the musket with primary use. Each shot consumes one fallen star and travels in a gravity arc. A shot can pierce up to three NPCs; each actual hit can send a separate star along the shot's direction. These stars home gradually toward nearby chaseable NPCs, deal 14 ranged damage on contact, and expire after 1.25 seconds. No hit means no follow-up star.
realization.playerExperience: The familiar musket cadence and three-target pierce remain. Fallen stars fund every trigger; the short-lived homing sparks reward hits without creating an independent firing loop.
